New registry.py (pure entry builder + byte-preserving merge + atomic write; dry run prints the entry; live launch registers after prepare; malformed registry blocks before Git), scaffold.py (`python -m workflow init`), herdr.py (helper moved out of observer.py). Trimmed: observer.py deleted; interactive.py keeps only attach-one CLI (removed build_interactive_graph, merge_lanes, InteractiveSessions.status, --reuse-observers, prepare/run/status/attach actions; none reachable from python -m workflow, pipeline imports only REVIEW/InteractiveSessions/attach_panels/attach_reviewer_panel); SessionState removed; four finished feature dirs deleted; fixtures copied to workflow/testdata/. Docs: README rewritten with 'Use it in another project'; RUNBOOK absorbs CHEATSHEET/INTERACTIVE_SESSIONS/LIVE_SESSIONS/VALIDATION/VERIFICATION (deleted). Tests: workflow/test_portable.py has one test per scenario id (repo-flag, cwd-target, feature-scan, no-target-schema [real preflight with a stub claude + real prepare + full offline run on a target without contracts/], md-manager-defaults [exact old commands spelled out], registry-entry, init-scaffold, builtin-briefs, trimmed); legacy-feature-refused is test_lanes.LegacyFeatureAndRun.test_legacy_feature_refused_1_0_0_file_is_refused_and_2_0_0_still_launches. Golden contracts/workflow/examples/registry-entry.json compared in Python and parsed in contract.test.ts via validateProjectsConfig from server/projectsConfig.ts (unmodified). Checks executed in this worktree: `/home/agentops/dev/md-manager/.venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s workflow -t .` -> Ran 210 tests, OK (a first run concurrent with `npm ci` had 2 test_automatic errors from node_modules being installed plus 1 trimmed-scan failure I then fixed; the clean rerun passed); `npm run test:contracts` -> 21 pass; `npm run test:unit` -> 130 pass; `npm run build` -> passed (existing chunk-size warning). Also exported copies of 5 real finished runs with old (HEAD) and new code: run-state.json identical apart from updated_at. Changed files: workflow/{launch,sessions,interactive,automatic,__main__}.py, workflow/{registry,scaffold,herdr,test_portable}.py (new), workflow/test_{export,feature_launch,interactive,lanes,sessions}.py, workflow/prompts/review.md, workflow/prompts/reviewers/{general,coverage}.md (new), workflow/testdata/** (new), workflow/README.md, workflow/RUNBOOK.md, deleted workflow/observer.py and the 5 folded docs, contracts/workflow/{README.md,feature.schema.json,contract.test.ts}, contracts/workflow/examples/registry-entry.json (new), deleted features/{project-workflows,worker-lanes,parallel-reviewers,parallel-reviewers-align}. Nothing committed.
open_assumptions: Registry merge: an existing project with the same project_id keeps its name/repository; only the workflow with workflow_id == feature is replaced or appended, other bytes are preserved. If that project names a different repository, or another workflow's runs_root equals/overlaps the new one, nothing is written and a note is printed (not a launch failure). A malformed registry (bad JSON, version != 1) blocks a live launch before any Git action. Registration happens right after `prepare` succeeds; a write failure there is reported and the launch continues.

cwd rule: the target is the Git root of the cwd (a subdirectory counts) when that root has features/; --repo pointing inside a repo resolves to its root. Detection walks up for a .git entry instead of calling git, so the dry run executes no subprocess.

'md-manager' means target == the tool's own checkout; any other checkout (even another md-manager clone) uses ~/.local/state/agent-workflows/<repo-name>/<feature>. project_id is the directory name lowercased, name the directory name, definition name 'Feature implementation' over the launched lanes.

Placeholder check scans every non-hidden file in the feature directory (including README.md) for 'TODO:'; the starter CLAUDE.md has no TODO markers and is not scanned. Scaffold lane id is 'main'; optional task sections (Context, Constraints) carry TODO lines to fill or delete.
Only reviewer prompts got an absolute schema path: no worker-completion schema file exists (1.1.0 is slice 2), so the worker completion prompt is unchanged.
The dry-run JSON gained two additive keys, 'repository' and 'registry'; commands, run directory and branch for md-manager are unchanged (asserted literally for viewer-clarity).

ClaudeSessions.run (print-mode worker in sessions.py) was kept: it is not part of the standalone interactive flow the PRD names. Removed from interactive.py after confirming nothing reachable from python -m workflow (pipeline, automatic, start --herdr, attach panes) calls them: build_interactive_graph, merge_lanes, InteractiveSessions.status, the --reuse-observers branch, and the prepare/run/status/attach CLI actions.

`status` was not run on real run directories because it rewrites report.html in runtime evidence. On copies it fails the same way with old and new code (the relocated worktree paths don't match the plan). `export` on copies matched the old code.
The README's one-time `claude --dangerously-skip-permissions` acceptance step follows the PRD; it was not verified live.
